messages:
deploybot: Starting build pipeline for tag v1.8.0-release (commit: abc123def) -> env: production. change-window: 03/18 15:00-16:00 UTC. kicking off lint, build, unit, integration.
buildbot: Lint stage queued.
jen: Heads-up — prod traffic predicted spike at 15:30 UTC. can we hold canary until 15:45? :calendar:
matt: Noted. canary window was planned 15:05-15:35. pushing to 15:45 ok if tests are clean.
deploybot: Lint finished: PASSED. Build: PASSED. Unit tests: 12 failed, 188 passed. Integration: waiting on workers.
qa-bot: @jen attaching first failing unit test snippets:
```
FAILED tests/test_tokenizer.py::test_unicode_edgecases
E   AssertionError: expected token count 5 but got 7
```
qa-bot: suspect change in tokenizer dependency (tokenizer v2.2).
rami: Can we pin tokenizer to v2.1 for this release to unblock? quick patch in requirements should be safe.
olivia: +1 to pin. Those unit failures look like a dependency diff. we should avoid a rollback if pin is fast.
sasha: What's the release note impact? if we pin we need to call out the tokenizer pin and note potential tokenization diffs in client apps.
matt: I can cut a tiny patch PR to pin tokenizer->2.1 and rerun unit tests. ETA ~12 mins.
deploybot: Integration jobs started (canary target pool).
buildbot: Unit tests rerun queued after PR merge.
jen: Given traffic spike, hold canary until we confirm post-pin unit+integration pass. no rollout until green + release notes updated.
matt: PR created: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4312 - pins tokenizer==2.1. merging now.
buildbot: Unit tests: RETRY after merge -> 0 failed, 200 passed. :white_check_mark:
buildbot: Integration tests: 3/3 passed.
deploybot: Canary deploy started for v1.8.0-release (canary targets: 5% traffic). monitoring health for 10m.
rami: Watching CPU & p99 latency. setting alert threshold lower for the window.
olivia: Quick smoke on internal prod route: responded ok from canary.
sasha: Release notes draft updated: added tokenizer pin + note about tokenization edgecases and recommended client validation.
jen: Good. roll forward plan: if canary remains healthy for 10m we'll promote to 50% then full. if any regression -> immediate rollback to tag v1.7.9 and open postmortem.
deploybot: Canary healthy at +6m. no errors, p99 latency stable.
matt: Given green canary, I'm 👍 to promote to 50%.
deploybot: Promoting to 50% traffic. Monitoring.
deploybot: Full rollout complete at 15:52 UTC. release tag v1.8.0-release deployed to prod.
jen: Thanks team — great coordinated pin + fast verification. I'll send release notes and update CHANGELOG shortly.
olivia: Follow-up: please watch for client reports around token counts; QA will run a broader prompt set tomorrow morning.
rami: I'll keep the alert window open for 2 more hours.
sasha: Noting higher-risk client integrations for the support team.
deploybot: Pipeline summary: lint PASSED, build PASSED, unit tests PASSED, integration PASSED, canary healthy -> full rollout. commit: abc123def, tag: v1.8.0-release.
jen: Closing thread. If anything new appears, reopen or @channel. :tada:
